summary_pt: Sistema acadêmico em Java para matrícula e biblioteca, com regras de negócio explícitas, persistência em MySQL e integração com microsserviços externos.

why_built.pt: Foi construído para praticar arquitetura em camadas, regras de negócio fortes e integração entre persistência local e serviços externos em um domínio acadêmico realista.

solution.en: A Java application with Controller, Service, Repository, and View layers, validating enrollments, reservations, and lookups while integrating three external APIs and storing operations locally in MySQL.

what_it_solves.pt: Centraliza consultas acadêmicas, controle de matrículas e biblioteca com regras explícitas para curso, status do aluno, vagas e reservas.
what_it_solves.en: It centralizes academic lookups, enrollment control, and library flows with explicit rules for course compatibility, student status, seat availability, and reservations.

target_users.pt: Operadores acadêmicos responsáveis por matrícula, consulta e biblioteca.
target_users.en: Academic operators responsible for enrollment, lookup, and library operations.

key_features: Parallel cache warm-up for external services

architecture.pt: Arquitetura em camadas com ConsoleView, controllers especializados, services de orquestração, repositories JDBC/MySQL e fachada para microsserviços externos.
architecture.en: Layered architecture with ConsoleView, specialized controllers, orchestration services, JDBC/MySQL repositories, and a facade for external microservices.

data_model.pt: Modelo relacional centrado em matrícula e reserva, com exceções específicas para regras de domínio.
data_model.en: Relational model centered on enrollments and reservations, with domain-specific exceptions for rule enforcement.

auth.pt: Não há autenticação de usuários finais explicitamente documentada no repositório.
auth.en: There is no explicitly documented end-user authentication flow in the repository.

integrations.pt: Integra três microsserviços REST externos e persiste operações locais em MySQL.
integrations.en: It integrates three external REST microservices and persists local operations in MySQL.

Strong business-rule enforcement
Good Java backend signaling
Explicit external integration model
Detailed README with technical structure

No explicit authentication layer

what_it_solves.pt: Organiza o ciclo completo de pedidos, gerenciamento de cardápio, endereços, entregas e avaliações em um único sistema operacional.

summary_pt: Sistema full stack de indicação com React, TypeScript, NestJS, SQLite e autenticação JWT, construído para demonstrar fluxo de usuários, autenticação e modelagem relacional recursiva.
summary_en: Full-stack referral system with React, TypeScript, NestJS, SQLite, and JWT authentication, built to demonstrate user flows, authentication, and recursive relational modeling.

problem.en: Referral systems need to register users securely, preserve the relationship between the invited user and the referrer, and expose that flow simply to the user.

why_built.pt: Foi construído para praticar NestJS, TypeScript full stack, autenticação JWT, modelagem com TypeORM e um fluxo de produto enxuto, mas completo.

solution.en: A TypeScript React SPA with a NestJS and SQLite backend, using JWT, referral links, a profile page, validation, and Context API to orchestrate authentication and user experience.

summary_pt: Portfólio autoral em React e TypeScript com motion editorial, GitHub stats, contato e chatbot com IA usando RAG sobre a própria trajetória técnica.
summary_en: Authorial portfolio in React and TypeScript focused on editorial motion, GitHub stats, contact flows, and an AI chatbot using RAG over Paulo's own technical history.

problem.pt: Um portfólio padrão comunica pouco sobre profundidade técnica e raramente permite exploração dinâmica sobre projetos, stacks e perfil profissional.
problem.en: A standard portfolio communicates little about technical depth and rarely allows dynamic exploration of projects, stacks, and professional profile.

why_built.pt: Foi construído para apresentar Paulo em um formato mais autoral, com melhor direção visual, integração com GitHub e um chatbot capaz de responder perguntas contextuais sobre a carreira e os projetos.
why_built.en: It was built to present Paulo in a more authorial format, with stronger visual direction, GitHub integration, and a chatbot capable of answering contextual questions about his career and projects.

solution.pt: Single-page app em React 19 e TypeScript, com hero scroll-driven, navegação responsiva, estatísticas do GitHub, contato com fallback e backend serverless para chat com múltiplos provedores e Supabase pgvector.
solution.en: A React 19 and TypeScript single-page app with a scroll-driven hero, responsive navigation, GitHub statistics, contact flow with fallback, and a serverless chat backend with multiple providers and Supabase pgvector.

what_it_solves.pt: Transforma o portfólio em uma experiência técnica mais explorável, unindo apresentação visual, contato e recuperação de conhecimento sobre Paulo e seus projetos.
what_it_solves.en: It turns the portfolio into a more explorable technical experience, combining visual presentation, contact, and knowledge retrieval about Paulo and his projects.

target_users.pt: Pessoas avaliando o perfil técnico de Paulo e querendo navegar rapidamente por projetos, stack e contexto profissional.
target_users.en: People evaluating Paulo's technical profile and wanting to navigate quickly through projects, stack, and professional context.

architecture.pt: Frontend React organizado em sections, contexts e hooks; backend Vercel em api com SSE, segurança, provider fallback e RAG em Supabase; estilo visual centralizado em src/index.css.
architecture.en: React frontend organized into sections, contexts, and hooks; Vercel backend in api with SSE, security, provider fallback, and Supabase RAG; visual style centralized in src/index.css.

data_model.pt: Modelo híbrido entre conteúdo de portfólio, chunks vetoriais, cache de embeddings e dados do GitHub para resposta contextual.
data_model.en: A hybrid model combining portfolio content, vector chunks, embedding cache, and GitHub data for contextual answers.

auth.en: There is no end-user authentication; the focus is on public content, basic API protection, and rate limiting.

integrations.pt: Integra dados do GitHub, envio de contato, múltiplos provedores de LLM e Supabase para RAG.
integrations.en: It integrates GitHub data, contact delivery, multiple LLM providers, and Supabase for RAG.

primary_flows: Ask questions in PT or EN

strengths: Most polished frontend in the portfolio
Live deploy and current maintenance
Strongest AI and integration story
Bilingual UX plus chat
Good mix of product presentation and implementation depth
tradeoffs: Public-content site rather than a business CRUD system
Chat accuracy depends on knowledge curation quality
Local dev chat behavior depends on backend availability

reliability.pt: Custo: roda inteiro em free tiers (Vercel, Supabase, Gemini/Groq). Latência: três camadas de cache reduzem chamadas e tempo de resposta, cache de respostas no servidor (TTL de 10 min), cache de respostas no cliente por sessão e cache de embeddings (em memória + tabela no Supabase). Falhas: rate limiting de 10 req/min por IP; cadeia de fallback de provedores (Gemini → Groq) acionada apenas em erros de quota/sobrecarga; o enriquecimento vetorial degrada silenciosamente para o contexto local determinístico se Supabase/Gemini estiverem indisponíveis, o chat sempre responde; canário anti-injeção de prompt substitui respostas comprometidas por um aviso de segurança.
reliability.en: Cost: runs entirely on free tiers (Vercel, Supabase, Gemini/Groq). Latency: three cache layers cut calls and response time, a server-side response cache (10-min TTL), a per-session client response cache, and an embedding cache (in-memory + Supabase table). Failures: 10 req/min per-IP rate limiting; the provider fallback chain (Gemini → Groq) engages only on quota/overload errors; vector enrichment degrades silently to the deterministic local context if Supabase/Gemini are unavailable, the chat always answers; a prompt-injection canary replaces compromised responses with a security notice.

Current chat backend documents SSE, provider fallback, and RAG implementation.

summary_pt: Marketplace universitário instalável de economia circular, com PWA em React, API Express e Prisma, autenticação JWT e fila offline no IndexedDB que publica anúncios com segurança após a reconexão.
summary_en: Installable university circular-economy marketplace with a React PWA, Express and Prisma API, JWT authentication, and an IndexedDB offline write queue that safely publishes listings after reconnection.

problem.pt: Itens usados dentro da comunidade universitária são descartados ou ficam ociosos porque estudantes não têm um fluxo local, confiável e resiliente para vender ou doar mesmo quando a conexão falha.
problem.en: Used items within a university community are discarded or left idle because students lack a local, trustworthy, resilient flow for selling or donating when connectivity fails.

why_built.pt: Foi construído para transformar a circulação de itens usados no campus em um produto full stack completo, combinando recursos de marketplace e PWA com um diferencial demonstrável: criar um anúncio em modo avião e publicá-lo sem duplicação após a reconexão.
why_built.en: It was built to turn the circulation of used items on campus into a complete full-stack product, combining marketplace and PWA capabilities with one demonstrable differentiator: creating a listing in airplane mode and publishing it without duplication after reconnection.

solution.pt: PWA React 19 e TypeScript com cache NetworkFirst para leituras, fila de escrita no IndexedDB, sincronização idempotente por UUID do cliente e API Express/Prisma implantada no Render sobre PostgreSQL Neon.
solution.en: A React 19 and TypeScript PWA with NetworkFirst read caching, an IndexedDB write queue, client-UUID idempotent synchronization, and an Express/Prisma API deployed on Render over Neon PostgreSQL.

what_it_solves.pt: Permite que estudantes encontrem, filtrem, vendam e doem itens usados e mantém a criação de anúncios disponível offline, conciliando o item local com o servidor depois que a rede retorna.
what_it_solves.en: It lets students discover, filter, sell, and donate used items while keeping listing creation available offline and reconciling the local item with the server after connectivity returns.

target_users.pt: Estudantes e membros da comunidade universitária que querem circular itens usados por venda ou doação.
target_users.en: Students and university community members who want to circulate used items through sales or donations.

key_features: Browse, search, and category or donation filters
Create, update, sell, donate, and remove listings
Exclusive anonymous or JWT identity mode

architecture.pt: Frontend React organizado por responsabilidades, service worker Workbox para shell e leituras offline, fila IndexedDB para escritas, transporte com contrato de identidade e API Express com validação zod, autorização, idempotência e persistência Prisma/PostgreSQL.
architecture.en: A responsibility-oriented React frontend, a Workbox service worker for the app shell and offline reads, an IndexedDB write queue, identity-aware transport, and an Express API with zod validation, authorization, idempotency, and Prisma/PostgreSQL persistence.

data_model.pt: Modelo relacional centrado em usuários e anúncios, com UUID gerado no cliente para idempotência e um estado local separado para itens pendentes, sincronizados ou falhos.
data_model.en: A relational model centered on users and listings, with client-generated UUIDs for idempotency and separate local state for pending, synchronized, or failed items.

auth.pt: Cada servidor ativa exatamente um resolvedor de identidade: UUID anônimo ou JWT com bcrypt e expiração de sete dias; credenciais dos dois modos nunca são aceitas como alternativas simultâneas.
auth.en: Each server activates exactly one identity resolver: an anonymous UUID or a seven-day JWT backed by bcrypt; credentials from both modes are never accepted as simultaneous alternatives.

integrations.pt: Integra frontend na Vercel, API no Render e PostgreSQL no Neon, com UptimeRobot tocando uma rota que consulta o banco para reduzir cold starts.
integrations.en: It integrates a Vercel frontend, Render API, and Neon PostgreSQL database, with UptimeRobot calling a database-backed route to reduce cold starts.

primary_flows: Mark an item sold or donated

strengths: Distinct offline-first product story
Full-stack deployment across independent managed services
Idempotent offline synchronization
Security-aware exclusive identity model
Strong automated and physical-device testing evidence
Project-specific Xilo-Feira visual system
Detailed engineering and AI-governance documentation
tradeoffs: JWT is stored in localStorage instead of httpOnly cookies
Images use URLs instead of uploads
Background Sync is deliberately out of scope
Server integration tests require a local PostgreSQL instance
Repository documentation has a few stale test-count and phase-status references

reliability.pt: Leituras usam NetworkFirst com timeout de quatro segundos; escritas offline permanecem no IndexedDB e seguem uma máquina de estados. Falhas de rede mantêm o item pendente, 401 aguarda novo login, 429 aplica backoff, 5xx tem tentativas limitadas e outros 4xx viram falhas visíveis. UUID do cliente e regra de propriedade tornam reenvios idempotentes.
reliability.en: Reads use NetworkFirst with a four-second timeout; offline writes remain in IndexedDB and follow a state machine. Network failures keep items pending, 401 waits for renewed login, 429 backs off, 5xx has bounded retries, and other 4xx responses become visible failures. Client UUIDs and ownership rules make resubmission idempotent.

summary_pt: Agente ReAct full-stack construído com US$ 0 de gasto em modelos/infra: LangGraph com traço de raciocínio/ação transmitido via SSE, memória entre conversas (checkpointer + long-term store em Postgres), RAG sobre documentos enviados pelo usuário com respostas citadas, traces persistidos e reexecutáveis com dashboard de histórico, e descoberta dinâmica de ferramentas via MCP, com baseline de avaliação de 100% em 22 casos rotulados e 154 testes de backend.
summary_en: A full-stack ReAct agent built on $0 of model/infra spend: LangGraph with the reasoning/action trace streamed over SSE, cross-conversation memory (Postgres checkpointer + long-term store), RAG over user-uploaded documents with cited answers, persisted replayable traces with a history dashboard, and dynamic tool discovery over MCP, with a 100% evaluation baseline on 22 labeled cases and 154 backend tests.

problem.pt: Agentes que usam ferramentas costumam expor apenas a resposta final, esquecem tudo entre conversas, alucinam sobre documentos e escondem o ciclo de raciocínio/ação, tornando o comportamento difícil de inspecionar, testar e operar.
problem.en: Tool-using agents usually expose only the final answer, forget everything between conversations, hallucinate about documents, and hide the reasoning/action cycle, making behavior hard to inspect, test, and operate.

why_built.pt: Começou como um agente transparente de ferramentas e evoluiu por um milestone de cinco fases (Fundação → Memória → RAG → Observabilidade → MCP) para demonstrar engenharia moderna de agentes dentro de cotas free-tier: operar um agente resiliente com limites rígidos de quota é tratado como parte da história de engenharia.
why_built.en: It started as a transparent tool-using agent and evolved through a five-phase milestone (Foundation → Memory → RAG → Observability → MCP) to demonstrate modern agent engineering inside free-tier quotas: operating a resilient agent within hard quota limits is treated as part of the engineering story.

solution.pt: Backend Python com StateGraph do LangGraph e fallback de provedores gratuitos (Gemini → Groq → GitHub Models), ferramentas explícitas (busca web, execução Python isolada, cálculo, memory_read/memory_write, document_search, fetch_url via MCP), persistência única em Supabase Postgres + pgvector (checkpointer, memória de longo prazo, documentos e traces) e uma camada FastAPI que transmite eventos via SSE para um frontend React 19/Vite com threads por conversa, histórico com replay e upload de documentos na barra de prompt.
solution.en: A Python backend with a LangGraph StateGraph and a free-provider fallback chain (Gemini → Groq → GitHub Models), explicit tools (web search, sandboxed Python execution, math, memory_read/memory_write, document_search, MCP fetch_url), a single Supabase Postgres + pgvector persistence backbone (checkpointer, long-term memory, documents, and traces), and a FastAPI layer streaming events over SSE to a React 19/Vite frontend with per-conversation threads, replayable history, and in-prompt document upload.

what_it_solves.pt: Entrega um agente que lembra fatos entre conversas (memory_read/memory_write aparecem como passos visíveis do traço), responde a partir de documentos enviados com citações de fonte e guarda anti-alucinação, persiste cada execução para replay com latência por passo e captura de fallback de provedor, e descobre ferramentas externas via MCP, tudo validado por casos rotulados executados contra o grafo real.
what_it_solves.en: It delivers an agent that remembers facts across conversations (memory_read/memory_write appear as visible trace steps), answers from uploaded documents with source citations and a no-hallucination guard, persists every run for replay with per-step latency and provider-fallback capture, and discovers external tools over MCP, all validated by labeled cases run against the real graph.

target_users.pt: Engenheiros e desenvolvedores que precisam inspecionar e avaliar o comportamento de agentes que usam ferramentas.
target_users.en: Engineers and developers who need to inspect and evaluate the behavior of tool-using agents.

key_features: ReAct loop as a LangGraph StateGraph
Cross-conversation memory: LangGraph PostgresSaver checkpointer + PostgresStore long-term store, with memory_read/memory_write as visible trace steps
Document RAG: upload PDF/text, Gemini free embeddings (768-dim), pgvector retrieval, cited answers with a no-hallucination guard
Persisted replayable run traces with per-step timing, token/cost usage, and provider-fallback capture
Conversation-grouped history dashboard with restore and replay
Dynamic MCP tool discovery from a companion FastMCP server over Streamable HTTP
Free-provider fallback chain: Gemini → Groq → GitHub Models
Per-conversation threads with New chat and in-prompt document upload
Tooling: web search, sandboxed Python execution, math
Evaluation harness over the real graph: 100% task success and tool selection on 22 labeled cases
Free-tier resilience: keep-alive cron, embedding batching with 429 backoff, graceful degradation

architecture.style: Agent backend plus streaming inspection frontend on a single Postgres backbone
architecture.pt: Grafo de estado LangGraph de 2 nós compilado por build_graph(), camada de LLMs com fallback de provedores gratuitos e rastreio de uso, ferramentas nativas + memória + RAG + MCP executadas no tool_node, persistência unificada em Supabase Postgres/pgvector (checkpointer, long-term store, documentos, traces) e API FastAPI que emite eventos SSE para hooks e painéis React dedicados, com separação user_id/thread_id (identidade estável por navegador vs. thread por conversa).
architecture.en: A 2-node LangGraph state graph compiled by build_graph(), an LLM layer with a free-provider fallback chain and usage tracking, native + memory + RAG + MCP tools executed in the tool_node, unified persistence on Supabase Postgres/pgvector (checkpointer, long-term store, documents, traces), and a FastAPI API emitting SSE events to dedicated React hooks and panels, with a user_id/thread_id split (stable browser identity vs. per-conversation thread).

data_model.pt: Estado do grafo orientado a mensagens e ferramentas, persistido em Supabase: checkpoints por thread, fatos de memória de longo prazo por usuário, chunks de documentos com embeddings pgvector e traces de execução reexecutáveis.
data_model.en: A message- and tool-oriented graph state persisted in Supabase: per-thread checkpoints, per-user long-term memory facts, document chunks with pgvector embeddings, and replayable run traces.

auth.pt: Não há autenticação de usuários finais; a identidade é anônima por navegador (user_id estável). A execução de Python é isolada por subprocess com validação AST e whitelist de imports, e as ferramentas de memória e documentos têm barreiras contra prompt injection.
auth.en: There is no end-user authentication; identity is anonymous per browser (stable user_id). Python execution is subprocess-isolated with AST validation and an import whitelist, and the memory and document tools carry prompt-injection barriers.

integrations.pt: Integra Supabase (memória, RAG e traces), embeddings gratuitos do Gemini, busca web Tavily, execução Python isolada, servidor MCP companion e cadeia de fallback de provedores gratuitos, transmitindo traços via SSE.
integrations.en: It integrates Supabase (memory, RAG, and traces), free Gemini embeddings, Tavily web search, sandboxed Python execution, a companion MCP server, and a free-provider fallback chain, streaming traces over SSE.

primary_flows: Upload a document and ask cited questions about it
Replay a past run from history

strengths: Reasoning/tool trace treated as a first-class product surface
Cross-conversation memory with memory operations visible in the trace
Document RAG with cited answers and a no-hallucination guard
Persisted replayable traces with provider-fallback capture
Dynamic MCP tool discovery rendered identically to native tools
100% evaluation baseline on 22 labeled cases plus 154 backend tests
Entire system operated on $0 free-tier spend
Live public deployment
tradeoffs: Python execution remains the most sensitive security surface despite subprocess isolation
Model-provider APIs and embedding quotas are unstable external dependencies
No end-user authentication layer (anonymous browser-scoped identity)

reliability.pt: Custo: US$ 0 total, operação inteira em free tiers (Gemini, Groq, GitHub Models, Supabase, Vercel), com a restrição tratada como parte da engenharia. Latência: cada passo do trace registra elapsed_ms, tokens e custo estimado via UsageTracker. Falhas: cadeia de fallback de provedores (Gemini → Groq → GitHub Models) com eventos de fallback capturados no trace; rate limiting de 10 req/min/IP (slowapi); loop limitado a 10 iterações; cron keep-alive na Vercel evita a pausa de 7 dias do Supabase free; batching de embeddings com backoff em 429; degradação graciosa, sem pool/store de banco, o agente continua respondendo sem memória/RAG em vez de quebrar.
reliability.en: Cost: $0 total, the whole system runs on free tiers (Gemini, Groq, GitHub Models, Supabase, Vercel), with that constraint treated as part of the engineering. Latency: every trace step records elapsed_ms, tokens, and estimated cost via a UsageTracker. Failures: a free-provider fallback chain (Gemini → Groq → GitHub Models) with fallback events captured in the trace; 10 req/min/IP rate limiting (slowapi); the loop is hard-capped at 10 iterations; a Vercel keep-alive cron prevents the Supabase free-tier 7-day pause; embedding batching with 429 backoff; graceful degradation, without the DB pool/store the agent still answers, just without memory/RAG, instead of breaking.

evidence_sources.note: Repository describes a ReAct agent with python executor, web search, and calculator tools.
Live public deployment of the agent inspector.
Vault page documents objective, stack, architecture flow, and engineering decisions.

summary_pt: Sistema completo de RAG capaz de operar offline: ingestão, indexação no ChromaDB, retrieval híbrido (BM25 + denso + fusão por reciprocal-rank + reranking), síntese por LLM com fallback extrativo e avaliação com métricas léxicas offline e RAGAS opcional na nuvem, tudo revisável em uma interface Streamlit.
summary_en: An end-to-end, offline-capable RAG system: ingestion, ChromaDB indexing, hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense + reciprocal-rank fusion + reranking), LLM synthesis with extractive fallback, and evaluation with offline lexical metrics plus optional cloud RAGAS, all reviewable in a Streamlit interface.

problem.pt: Muitas demos de RAG são apenas busca vetorial e param de funcionar sem provedores pagos, sem oferecer avaliação honesta nem permitir trocar estratégias de retrieval de forma independente.
problem.en: Many RAG demos are just vector search and stop working without paid providers, offering no honest evaluation and no way to swap retrieval strategies independently.

why_built.pt: Foi construído para tratar RAG como um sistema de engenharia, separando ingestão, retrieval, síntese, orquestração e avaliação, com métricas léxicas offline e fallbacks extrativos para manter o sistema testável e honesto quando a nuvem não está disponível.
why_built.en: It was built to treat RAG as an engineering system, separating ingestion, retrieval, synthesis, orchestration, and evaluation, with offline lexical metrics and extractive fallbacks to keep it testable and honest when cloud services are unavailable.

solution.pt: Aplicação Python/Streamlit que cobre todo o ciclo: carregamento de fontes, ingestão e indexação no ChromaDB, retrieval híbrido com fusão e reranking, síntese por LLM com fallback extrativo, e avaliação com golden datasets, métricas léxicas offline e execução opcional de RAGAS na nuvem.
solution.en: A Python/Streamlit application covering the full cycle: source loading, ingestion and ChromaDB indexing, hybrid retrieval with fusion and reranking, LLM synthesis with extractive fallback, and evaluation with golden datasets, offline lexical metrics, and optional cloud RAGAS execution.

what_it_solves.pt: Entrega um RAG configurável e avaliável que continua útil sem provedores pagos, permitindo comparar estratégias de retrieval e políticas de provedor de forma independente e auditável.
what_it_solves.en: It delivers a configurable, evaluable RAG that stays useful without paid providers, letting retrieval strategies and provider policies be compared independently and auditably.

target_users.pt: Engenheiros que projetam, comparam e avaliam pipelines de RAG e estratégias de retrieval.
target_users.en: Engineers who design, compare, and evaluate RAG pipelines and retrieval strategies.

key_features: Source loading from files, PDF, DOCX, GitHub/Hugging Face
Hybrid retrieval: BM25 + dense + reciprocal-rank fusion
Golden datasets and offline lexical metrics
Opt-in cloud RAGAS evaluation with degradation states
Streamlit ingestion, query, and evaluation review UI

architecture.style: Modular RAG pipeline with Streamlit review UI
architecture.pt: Camadas separadas de source_loader, ingestion, retrieval, pipeline, synthesis e evaluate/cloud_ragas, expostas por um app Streamlit, permitindo trocar estratégias e políticas de provedor independentemente.
architecture.en: Separated source_loader, ingestion, retrieval, pipeline, synthesis, and evaluate/cloud_ragas layers exposed through a Streamlit app, so strategies and provider policies can be swapped independently.

data_model.pt: Modelo centrado em fontes versionadas, chunks vetoriais no ChromaDB, golden datasets e relatórios de avaliação.
data_model.en: A model centered on versioned sources, vector chunks in ChromaDB, golden datasets, and evaluation reports.

auth.pt: Não há autenticação de usuários finais; o foco é avaliação reprodutível e políticas explícitas de provedor.
auth.en: There is no end-user authentication; the focus is reproducible evaluation and explicit provider policies.

integrations.pt: Integra ChromaDB, retrieval léxico e denso, reranking, provedores de LLM e RAGAS opcional na nuvem.
integrations.en: It integrates ChromaDB, lexical and dense retrieval, reranking, LLM providers, and optional cloud RAGAS.

strengths: Treats RAG as a full engineering system, not a single vector-search demo
Works offline with honest lexical metrics and extractive fallback
Hybrid retrieval ablatable into individual strategies
Extensive test suite with fake Streamlit/runtime/provider components
Live public Streamlit deployment
tradeoffs: Streamlit UI is utilitarian rather than highly polished
Some evaluation/UI modules show low community cohesion and could be decomposed
Persistent Chroma data needs a deliberate hosting target

reliability.pt: Custo: projetado para operar com US$ 0, o sistema inteiro continua útil sem provedores pagos, com métricas léxicas offline e fallback extrativo quando nenhum LLM está disponível. Falhas: RAGAS na nuvem é opt-in, com execução limitada e estados de degradação explícitos (a avaliação offline nunca reporta silenciosamente métricas de nuvem); corrupção ou coleção ausente no ChromaDB é tratada com caminhos de reset e retry; o reranker é exposto honestamente em vez de fingir que um cross-encoder está sempre ativo.
reliability.en: Cost: designed to run on $0, the whole system stays useful without paid providers, with offline lexical metrics and an extractive fallback when no LLM is available. Failures: cloud RAGAS is opt-in, with bounded execution and explicit degradation states (offline evaluation never silently reports cloud metrics); ChromaDB corruption or missing collections are handled through reset-and-retry paths; the reranker is surfaced honestly instead of implying a cross-encoder is always active.

evidence_sources.note: Repository describes Advanced RAG with RAGAS evaluation.
Live public Streamlit deployment.
Vault page documents lifecycle, hybrid retrieval, evaluation, and engineering decisions.

summary_pt: Fine-tuning QLoRA do Phi-3 Mini (3.8B) da Microsoft para gerar SQL a partir de linguagem natural, treinado em 4-bit numa única GPU T4 em ~21 min; eleva a acurácia exact-match de 2% (modelo base) para 73,5%, publicado no Hugging Face Hub como adapter LoRA e modelo mesclado.
summary_en: A QLoRA fine-tune of Microsoft's Phi-3 Mini (3.8B) for natural-language-to-SQL, trained 4-bit on a single T4 GPU in ~21 min; it lifts exact-match accuracy from 2% (base model) to 73.5%, published to the Hugging Face Hub as both a LoRA adapter and a merged model.

problem.pt: Modelos base pequenos geram SQL com baixa acurácia (cerca de 2% exact-match) e o fine-tuning completo é caro demais para hardware acessível.
problem.en: Small base models generate SQL with low accuracy (around 2% exact match), and full fine-tuning is too expensive for accessible hardware.

why_built.pt: Foi construído para demonstrar competência em ML ops e fine-tuning completo, do dataset à publicação no Hugging Face Hub, usando fine-tuning eficiente em parâmetros viável em uma única GPU T4.
why_built.en: It was built to demonstrate ML ops and end-to-end fine-tuning competence, from dataset to Hugging Face Hub publication, using parameter-efficient fine-tuning feasible on a single T4 GPU.

solution.pt: Pipeline QLoRA (LoRA com quantização 4-bit NF4) sobre o Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct: preparo do dataset SQL Create Context em formato instrução, treino de adapters LoRA, avaliação por exact-match e publicação do adapter e do modelo mesclado no Hub.
solution.en: A QLoRA pipeline (LoRA with 4-bit NF4 quantization) over Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct: preparing the SQL Create Context dataset into instruction format, training LoRA adapters, evaluating by exact match, and publishing the adapter and merged model to the Hub.

what_it_solves.pt: Entrega um gerador de SQL (SELECT) a partir de linguagem natural com 73,5% de exact-match, treinável de forma barata e reprodutível, com demo pública no Hugging Face Spaces.
what_it_solves.en: It delivers a natural-language-to-SQL (SELECT) generator with 73.5% exact match, trainable cheaply and reproducibly, with a public demo on Hugging Face Spaces.

target_users.pt: Engenheiros de ML e desenvolvedores interessados em fine-tuning eficiente e geração de SQL.
target_users.en: ML engineers and developers interested in efficient fine-tuning and SQL generation.

key_features: Published to the Hugging Face Hub

architecture.pt: Pipeline em notebooks (preparo de dataset, treino QLoRA, avaliação) sincronizado via Drive e executado no Colab com GPU T4, publicando artefatos no Hugging Face Hub.
architecture.en: A notebook pipeline (dataset prep, QLoRA training, evaluation) synced via Drive and run on Colab with a T4 GPU, publishing artifacts to the Hugging Face Hub.

data_model.pt: Dados de instrução derivados do SQL Create Context (1.000 treino + 200 validação) e artefatos de modelo publicados.
data_model.en: Instruction data derived from SQL Create Context (1,000 train + 200 validation) and published model artifacts.

auth.pt: Não se aplica: é um projeto de treino e publicação de modelo, sem autenticação de usuários.
auth.en: Not applicable: it is a model training and publishing project, without user authentication.

integrations.pt: Integra dataset do Hugging Face, treino no Colab e publicação de adapter, modelo mesclado e demo no Hub/Spaces.
integrations.en: It integrates a Hugging Face dataset, Colab training, and publication of the adapter, merged model, and demo on the Hub/Spaces.

strengths: Large measurable gain: 2% to 73.5% exact match
Efficient 4-bit training on a single free-tier T4
Complete pipeline from dataset to published artifacts
Adapter and merged model both published on the Hub
Public Hugging Face Spaces demo and detailed documentation
tradeoffs: Trained on SELECT queries only (no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL)
Best on low-to-medium complexity queries; weaker on multi-JOINs and nested subqueries
Not tested against dialect-specific SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL)

reliability.pt: Custo: US$ 0 de treino, Colab free tier com uma única GPU T4, dentro de limites diários apertados de uso; a quantização 4-bit NF4 foi o que tornou viável treinar um modelo de 3,8B nesse hardware. Latência de treino: ~21 minutos para 1.000 exemplos de treino + 200 de validação. Falhas/limites conhecidos e documentados: só SELECT (sem INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL), melhor em queries de complexidade baixa a média, não testado em dialetos específicos, limitações publicadas junto com o modelo em vez de escondidas.
reliability.en: Cost: $0 training, Colab free tier on a single T4 GPU, within tight daily usage caps; 4-bit NF4 quantization is what made training a 3.8B model feasible on that hardware. Training latency: ~21 minutes for 1,000 train + 200 validation examples. Known, documented failure limits: SELECT-only (no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL), strongest on low-to-medium query complexity, untested on dialect-specific SQL, limitations published alongside the model rather than hidden.

evidence_sources.note: Repository describes a QLoRA fine-tuned model trained on a T4 GPU for SQL generation.
Public Hugging Face Spaces demo.
Published LoRA adapter documenting the training pipeline.
Vault page documents dataset, training, metrics, capabilities, and limitations.
